themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI systems designed to act autonomously in research tasks, such as conducting experiments, generating hypotheses, or performing complex analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, refactor, and understand code.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Articles discussing how AI is used to analyze, interpret, and extract insights from various forms of data, including user behavior and market trends.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles detailing specific AI-powered platforms, software, or tools designed to assist researchers in their work, from literature review to data collection.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Explores the use of AI to understand customer behavior, preferences, sentiment, and needs through various data sources.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles on AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text, such as research papers, articles, or user feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI design & research
themes.description: Covers the intersection of AI in the design process, including AI-assisted prototyping, UI/UX design generation, and creative tool development.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on AI-generated personas or user data used for testing, simulation, or research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discusses how AI technologies are affecting employment, job roles, skills requirements, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles that specifically investigate the behavior, impact, reliability, and user interaction patterns of AI-powered chatbots.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
